Class MockupOffer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.client.view.mockupModel.MockupOffer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Rectangable, Serializable
public class MockupOffer extends Object implements Serializable, Rectangable
The MockupOffer class represents a single slot on the offer board within the game's client-side mockup. Players can assign themselves to an offer to gain specific rewards such as food or the ability to draw cards from the upper or lower lines. It implements Rectangable to allow the text-based user interface to render it as a styled ASCII box.

      public MockupOffer(int foodGain, int upperDraw, int lowerDraw, Integer assignedPlayerIndex)
      Constructs a new MockupOffer with the specified rewards and initial state.
      Parameters:
      foodGain - the amount of food provided by the offer.

    • getRectangleAttributedString

      public RectangleAttributedString getRectangleAttributedString()
      Generates a graphical representation of the offer using ASCII characters and ANSI colors. The resulting box is 5 characters wide and 5 lines tall. It dynamically displays the assigned player's colored totem (or a placeholder if empty) and the specific rewards (food or colored arrows indicating card draws).
      Specified by:
      getRectangleAttributedString in interface Rectangable
      Returns:
      a RectangleAttributedString containing the stylized box.
